candidates.change_summary: Change transfer target from Owner to msg.sender so withdraw sends contract balance to the caller instead of the stored Owner.
Remove the require check allowing anyone to call withdraw, so the contract sends balance to Owner regardless of caller.
Change transfer amount to send zero value, so withdraw no longer transfers funds.
Invert the require condition so only non-Owner callers can invoke withdraw, preventing the original Owner from withdrawing.
Replace transfer with a low-level call that forwards all gas and ignores failure, changing behavior on transfer failure.
Replace low-level call without checking return value with a call that requires success, causing revert on failed external calls (adds require around adr.call).
Change the comparison in the if condition from >= to > so the branch triggers in one fewer case, altering when a transfer (which affects observable balance via payable(adr).transfer) occurs.
Invert the if condition to only execute the transfer when msg.value < address(this).balance, changing which calls perform the observable transfer.
Remove the if check so the transfer always executes (subject to require), causing the contract to send funds on every call and thus changing observed balances.
Change transfer amount to only the incoming msg.value instead of balance+msg.value, altering how much is sent and thus observable balances.
Change transfer target from adr to msg.sender so the recipient of funds (observable externally) differs after the call.
Replace the require with a revert-free no-op so calls that previously reverted now proceed to transfer, changing observable behavior.
